shortDescription: Malaysian state energy firm Petronas (IPO-PETO.KL) said on Thursday it had delivered its maiden bio-LNG cargo from Malaysia to Japan in partnership with Tokyo Gas Co TSE:9531.

children: Malaysian state energy firm Petronas (IPO-PETO.KL) said on Thursday it had delivered its maiden bio-LNG cargo from Malaysia to Japan in partnership with Tokyo Gas Co
The delivery follows a memorandum of understanding signed by the companies on October 27 to expand collaboration across the LNG value chain and explore decarbonisation opportunities
The first bio-LNG cargo was co-loaded with conventional LNG at the Pengerang regasification terminal in Johor and was delivered through Petronas' LNG infrastructure, which Petronas Gas operates

"By combining Malaysia's biomethane potential with the scale, reliability and market reach of our established LNG portfolio, we are creating pathways for renewable gas to reach international markets while continuing to provide the energy security our customers depend on," said Datuk Adif Zulkifli, Petronas executive vice president and CEO of the gas and maritime business
The MoU builds on a partnership of more than four decades between the two companies
